MPLADS_PROJECTS.subject: MPLADS works recommended by {mp_name}, {mp_title}, {area}
questions: Please provide the list of all works recommended under MPLADS by {mp_name}, {mp_title}, for {area}, with the name of each work, date of recommendation and estimated cost.
For each such work, please state the amount sanctioned, the amount released to the implementing agency, and the date of release.
Please state the current status of each work (not started, in progress or completed), with the date of completion where applicable.
Please state the total MPLADS funds released and the unspent balance for this Member in the same period, as per your records.

ATTENDANCE.subject: Attendance and parliamentary activity of {mp_name}, {mp_title}
questions: Please provide the number of sittings of the {house_name} held in the period, and the number of sittings for which {mp_name} ({area}) signed the attendance register.
Please provide the number of questions (starred and unstarred) asked by {mp_name} in the period, with the date and subject of each.
Please provide the list of committees of which {mp_name} was a member in the period, and the number of committee meetings attended.

ALLOWANCES.subject: Salary and allowances paid to {mp_name}, {mp_title}
questions: Please provide the total amount paid to {mp_name} in the period under each head: salary, constituency allowance, office expense allowance and daily allowance.
Please provide the total number of journeys and total amount paid under travel entitlements (air, rail and road) for {mp_name} in the period, as category-wise totals.
